console.being_in_the_network_is_not_bein: Being in the network is not being trusted. Each application sets its own idea of too much — only chat knows what too many messages is — and reports the sender; this node decides what the reports add up to. A node past the first threshold stops being served, silently: it is told nothing, so it learns as late as possible. Complaints fade on their own, so a node that misbehaved once and then behaved comes back without anyone doing anything.
